title: cvpw cues/cues.json
description: The only permitted home for an off-grid time (docs/SPEC.md T8). Every cue records its provenance so a re-analysis can refine a guess without ever overwriting a human's ear correction.

id.description: Must be unique. Readable by a human weeks later: `chorus_in`, not `c7`.

t.description: Seconds from the start of the piece.

source.description: `measured` from audio, `analysis` derived by a pass, `audit` reviewed by a tool, `initial` a guess, `manual` set by ear. Tools may refine the first four; `manual` is never overwritten.

note.description: Why this value, or what remains uncertain about it.

usedBy.description: Optional: shot ids that reference this cue. Written by tooling so that deleting a referenced cue can fail with the referencing ids rather than silently breaking a cut.
